pages.text: Two compasses answer the two questions a traveler actually asks — $(italic)where is the nearest$() biome, and where is the nearest structure. Neither replaces the $(l:4_wayfaring/atlas)Antique Atlas$(): they point, the atlas remembers.
pages.title: Compasses

pages.text: $(bold)Nature's Compass$() finds $(italic)biomes$(). Right-click to open a searchable list of every biome in the pack; choose one and the needle turns toward the nearest example, with its distance. The fast way to a cherry grove, a mushroom island, or whatever biome a recipe or a build wants.
pages.title: Nature's Compass

pages.text: $(bold)Explorer's Compass$() does the same for $(italic)structures$() — villages, mansions, monuments, ocean ruins, and the pack's $(italic)Repurposed Structures$() additions. Open it, pick a structure, and follow the needle.$(br2)$(bold)$(novus)On overlap.$()$() $(italic)Quark's$() $(bold)Pathfinder's Quill$() buys single-use $(italic)biome maps$() from a cartographer — the same job as Nature's Compass, by map instead of needle. Use whichever you have; they don't conflict.
pages.title: Explorer's Compass
